artworks.title: Laurent Cars
artworks.artist: Simon Charles Miger after Jean-Baptiste Perronneau
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man named Laurent Cars. He is depicted in a three-quarter view facing left with a composed expression, raised eyebrows, and a slight smile. His facial features are clear, with curly light-colored hair. He is dressed in a classical style coat and shirt, with ornamental elements surrounding him in an oval frame. Below the image are his name and titles inscribed in French: "LAURENT CARS, Graveur du Roi Conseiller en son Academie Royale de Peinture et de Sculpture." The engraving has a textured background and a rectangular border.

artworks.title: Nous n'avons pas le patience d'attendre que nous fussions seuls
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and brush and black ink with gray wash
artworks.description: The image displays a man and a woman embracing in the center. The man is wearing 18th-century attire, including a tricorn hat and an elaborate coat. The woman is lifted off the ground by the man, wearing a formal dress with detailed ruffles. Around them are other figures, including what appears to be children observing them. The background shows a lively environment, possibly a social gathering or a busy room. The room features a fireplace with various items, a high mantle with vases and dishes, exposed wooden beams on the ceiling, and a small dog on the floor.

artworks.title: Le concert agreable
artworks.artist: Charles Nicolas Varin after Nicolas Lavreince
artworks.description: The image shows an outdoor scene with people engaged in various activities. The horizon is low, with a forest extending upwards and blending into the sky. The brushstrokes are detailed, depicting textures of foliage and clothing. The color palette consists of shades of sepia and monochrome. A man plays the guitar under a tree, accompanied by a lady. Two other ladies lean in to listen, one holding a book. In the distance, a man lounges with a violin. The background displays a variety of tree species.

artworks.title: Le dejeuner anglais
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals gathered around a small round table. One man is sitting with his back turned, reading a document or newspaper, while a woman stands beside him, pouring or serving from a teapot. Another woman is seated, engaging with a second woman. The seated woman wears a long dress with delicate ruffles and holds a piece of jewelry, possibly a ring. The man has an 18th-century hairstyle tied with a ribbon. A dog stands near the seated woman. The room is lavishly decorated with ornate wall paneling, a mantelpiece featuring a large clock and decorative items, and a luxurious curtain in the background.

artworks.title: La lecon interrompue
artworks.description: The image depicts four individuals in an ornately decorated room. On the left, an adult male figure in 18th-century attire sits on a chair next to a table with hats. In the center, a woman sits wearing a large hat and a voluminous dress, with a child standing in front of her. Another woman stands on the left holding a small drum. The room features a round portrait, a folding screen, and luxurious drapery, with a wooden parquet floor.

artworks.title: Le roman dangereux
artworks.description: This print shows a woman lying on a bed with a man leaning over a chair beside her. The woman is in the center of the print, with her head towards the left and her feet towards the bottom right corner. She is dressed in a gown with a low neckline, lying on her back with her head on a pillow and her arm bent by her head. Her eyes are closed. She has light skin and her hair is in an elaborate updo. The wide skirts of her dress are spread out across the bed, and one of her feet rests on a cushioned footrest. The man is to the right, leaning over a cushioned chair towards the sleeping woman's face. He has light skin and curled white hair, and he wears a long coat with ruffles at the cuffs and neckline. He is looking towards her and has one finger raised to his lips. The room is ornately decorated with heavy curtains above the bed, large decorative urns, and a high circular ceiling.

artworks.title: La Consolation de l'absence
artworks.description: This print shows a woman sitting on a cushioned settee in an ornate room. She extends her one arm outward, holding a small round object that seems to feature a small portrait of a man. She is looking towards this portrait. The woman has pale skin and light-colored hair in an elaborate hairstyle that features lace and feathers. She is wearing an elegant gown with a low, lacy neckline, a fitted bodice, and a wide, flowing skirt. The room is richly decorated with detailed wall coverings and a large, framed picture of a cherub on the wall. The cherub is positioned above her, and it appears to point an arrow directly at the woman. On the left, a small round table near the woman holds a tea set and some other objects, and a small dog stands beside it, looking to the left. On the left is a shelf supporting a large decorative vase and a statue below a large, ornate mirror, while on the right is a large, draped curtain and a chair with a musical instrument on it. This central image is surrounded by a border, and below it are several lines of text.

artworks.title: Les deux confidantes
artworks.description: In this print, two women are seated closely together on a grassy hill. The two women have pale skin, light, curly hair, arched eyebrows, and long, straight noses. They wear dresses with puffed sleeves and long, draped skirts. The woman on the right is seated slightly below the other, and she looks up at her companion. The arm of the woman on the left is draped around the shoulders of the woman on the right. The woman on the left has a bird on her lap, and the other woman reaches toward it. They appear to be tying a small letter to the bird with string. On the ground around them are several sheep and a dog, sitting and standing among bushes and blooming flowers. In the background, behind the woman on the left, is a stone platform with what appears to be a statue of a lion laying on it. There are also tall, leafy trees, and on the right is a pale, cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Venus et les amours
artworks.description: The image shows a person next to a fallen tree in a natural setting. The person is in a seated position, looking to the side. Features include curly hair, delicate facial features, and a draped garment exposing one shoulder. The environment features dense foliage, birds, putti, and large trees. In the background, billowing clouds envelop the scene. A decorative crest below contains symbolic elements.

artworks.title: Le Bon Exemple
artworks.description: The image shows a woman sitting on a chair, sewing. She is positioned in profile, looking down at a piece of fabric. She has a lace cap on her styled hair, her face has a gentle expression. The woman wears a detailed dress with ruffles, lace trim, and a choker. Next to her, a table holds sewing materials. The background shows a patterned wall and draped curtain, within an ornate frame.

artworks.title: Mademoiselle Sa Soeur
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated on a chair, engaged with a spinning wheel. She has an upright posture and is looking towards the viewer. She has an oval face framed by a lace-trimmed bonnet and styled hair. She is wearing an elegant gown with lace details, long sleeves, and an apron. She holds a spindle in her right hand and the spinning wheel is near her knees. In the background, there is wooden paneling and a mantelpiece with decorative items. The scene is framed within an elaborate frame.

artworks.title: Mlle. Salle
artworks.artist: Nicolas de Larmessin IV after Nicolas Lancret
artworks.description: The image depicts several figures in elaborate, historical attire positioned in a formal outdoor setting. The central figure, a woman in a detailed gown, is shown dancing with one arm extended. Three other women in similar attire are dancing nearby. On the right, a group of men is playing musical instruments. In the background, classical columns and a partial statue can be seen amid trees. The scene is rendered in a monochromatic palette, emphasizing the clothing's intricacies and the background foliage.

artworks.title: Le matin
artworks.artist: Nicolas de Larmessin IV after Nicolas Lancret
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of three individuals in a richly decorated interior setting. The man, seated on the left, wears a long coat with a shirt that has a white ruffle around the neck and cuffs. His hair is styled back. The woman in the center is seated on a couch, extending her arm to pour tea or coffee from a pot into cups on a table. The woman standing to the right is holding lace and observing. They are all dressed elegantly with detailed lacework. The background includes decorative wall hangings, framed pictures, molding, draped curtains, and a window.

artworks.title: Le midi
artworks.artist: Nicolas de Larmessin IV after Nicolas Lancret
artworks.description: The image shows four individuals, three women and one man, standing in front of an ornate fountain with a sculpture of a child holding an arrow pointing to a sundial. The women wear 18th-century gowns, styled hair, and hold decorative objects. The man is seated next to them, wearing a detailed long coat. The background features dense foliage, suggesting a garden or wooded area.

artworks.title: L'apres-diner
artworks.artist: Nicolas de Larmessin IV after Nicolas Lancret
artworks.description: This is a print of four people gathered around a table outdoors. In the center, there is a rectangular table with thin legs, set with dice and game pieces. Two of the people sit at the table, a woman on the right and a man on the left. Two more women stand behind the man, who looks over his shoulder towards them. All of the people have pale skin, and the women wear long dresses with wide skirts and ruffled sleeves, and their hair is put up under small cloth bonnets. The man wears a long jacket with large buttons, which is open to reveal a white shirt and trousers that go down to his knees. He wears black buckled shoes, and his hair is curled. The group is surrounded by leafy trees and bushes, and a cloudy sky is visible on the left. Below the scene, there are several lines of words on the beige paper.

artworks.title: La soiree
artworks.artist: Nicolas de Larmessin IV after Nicolas Lancret
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of five figures in a natural setting. The scene shows the figures gathered around a small pool of water in a lush and wooded area. Some figures are inside a boat-like structure supported by arching branches, while others are seated on the ground or wading into the water. The environment is dense with trees and natural foliage, with the moon visible in the sky. The figures appear to be engaged in a leisurely and intimate interaction. The composition is detailed, with attention to textures of clothing, foliage, and the water's surface.

artworks.title: La Declaration
artworks.artist: Charles-Clement Bervic after Louis Rolland Trinquesse
artworks.description: The image depicts three individuals in period attire. In the center, a woman stands elegantly with one hand resting on her hip, facing the viewer slightly. She has intricate, voluminous hair styled with curls and adorned with feathers or a headpiece. Her gown is ornate and flowing, made of a luxurious fabric with a full skirt. Next to her is another woman who is seated on a pedestal. She also wears a finely detailed dress with ruffles and has similarly styled curly hair. The seated woman's gaze is directed towards the central figure. Kneeling by the central figure's dress's hem is a man, who appears to kiss or closely observe her garment. He wears a lavishly decorated coat with embroidered details and visible ruffles at his sleeves. Nearby stands a statue of a cherub, holding a floral wreath, possibly made of leaves. The background features grand architectural elements, including tall columns and a partially visible domed structure. Beyond the architecture are dense trees, suggesting a garden or wooded area.

artworks.title: Le Serment
artworks.artist: Charles-Clement Bervic after Louis Rolland Trinquesse
artworks.description: The image depicts four people: two standing and two seated on the ground. One standing man is supporting a woman who is slightly leaning back with her arm raised. The woman has elaborate hairstyles, and both characters are dressed in ornate, historical clothing. The other seated man and woman seem to be engaged in conversation. The setting features dense foliage, trees, and ruins in the background, including a statue with a female figure and a cupid-like child.

artworks.title: La Fontaine d'Amour (The Fountain of Love)
artworks.artist: Nicolas François Regnault after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: This is a painting depicting mythical figures gathered around a fountain. The scene shows angelic cherubs with wings surrounding two female figures. The figures are engaging in interaction among clouds. Water cascades from the fountain into a pool, and trees frame the scene. The painting is done in the style of François Boucher.

artworks.title: Le Songe d'Amour (Love's Dream)
artworks.artist: Nicolas François Regnault after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: This etching depicts several people among the clouds. In the center left, a reclining person rests on a low bed, swathed in fabric. Next to them, in the bottom left, a helmet with a white plume and a sword have been discarded. Above them and to the right, another person draped in white fabric is seated among clouds, holding a pitcher. They are surrounded by winged cherubs who play in the puffy clouds. One cherub appears to bring a lit torch to the sleeping figure, while another rests by the sword at their feet. Below, on a lower platform, there are two resting dogs. In the top left corner is a shape that appears to be a large column.

artworks.title: Le Chiffre d'amour
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in a side profile view, standing and leaning forward towards a tree. She seems to be carving or writing on the tree. She has delicate facial features, styled hair, and wears an elegant gown. A dog sits beside her on a stone bench. The background includes a large tree, foliage, and a cloudy sky. The image is bordered and titled at the bottom.

artworks.title: La Bascule
artworks.description: This late 18th-century engraving features three individuals in a lush, natural setting with trees. The main figure, a woman, is sitting on a swing or a tree. She has soft facial features, with an upturned nose and plump cheeks, elegantly arranged hair, and is wearing a voluminous dress with intricate folds, highlighted with shadows and texture, puffed sleeves, and possibly a corset. Next to her, a young boy kneels on the ground, wearing a brimmed hat. The third figure is a smaller child clinging to the boy's arm. Both boys are dressed in period clothing. The ground is detailed with floral patterns, textures, and an ornate container with decorative fabric, possibly holding fruits. The background shows dense foliage and trees, suggesting a serene woodland setting. French text is inscribed at the bottom of the image.
